true_answer: Or you could capture the free variable by quantifying over it, as in, “for all values of x , 3 + x | 12 ,” which is false. We will discuss quantifiers in more detail at the end of this section. You can build more complicated (molecular) statements out of simpler (atomic or molecular) ones using logical connectives . For example, this is a molecular statement: Telephone numbers in the USA have 10 digits and 42 is a perfect square. Note that we can break this down into two smaller statements.
